thread:
Sam: p99 spike again when short chat + bulk training mix on same worker. Need a new take on queueing that preserves interactive p99 without killing throughput.
Priya: Proposal: ticketing where requests buy ticket units proportional to length. Scheduler fills cohorts by ticket budget, biasing short requests.
Diego: Add age-based fairness so long requests gain priority over time to avoid starvation. Also ensure a min_long_fraction per cohort for throughput.
Noor: Tie scheduler to measured tokens/sec: if tokens/sec falls, temporarily favor throughput windows. Emit cohort tokens/sec and KV cache warmness.
Sam: Edge-case handling: early-429 when fast ticket budget exhausted with Retry-After + pointer to background endpoint. Better UX than huge latency.
Priya: Sim sketch: mixed arrivals (70% short mean=140, 30% long mean=2500), ticket_unit=100, cohort_budget=50 units, age_boost=0.05/s.
Diego: We'll prototype sim and a staging scheduler. infra-bot: feature-flag ticket_cohort_experiment_v1=false created.
Sam: I'll open RFC follow-up with knobs: ticket_unit_size, cohort_ticket_budget, age_boost_rate, min_long_fraction, throughput_window_len, sticky_ttl. Thanks all.
